Non-naïve T cell sorted samples were additionally gated as cells that were not CD45RA+CCR7+. Non-naïve CD4 and CD8 sorted samples were additionally gated on CD4+ and CD8+, respectively.

Cells were with either a panel of 60 or 101 Total-Seq-C antibodies that also labeled samples individually through sample-specific barcodes. Cells were pooled and loaded on the 10x Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Kit (v2) using a superloading strategy, mixing cells from different samples in each 10x lane. TCR sequences were enriched using the human V(D)J B/T cell enrichment. Libraries were prepared according to manufacturer’s protocol (10x Genomics).
description: 10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Kit (v2)
data_processing: CellRanger v7.0.0 count was run on GEX and ADT fastqs together to generate a matrix containing both gene and protein counts, supplying a Feature Reference csv file containing the feature barcode library. CellRanger vdj was run on VDJ reads.
Assembly: GRCh38-2020-A
Supplementary files format and content: CellRanger output files containing both GEX and ADT data: barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz (linked to the corresponding GEX sample records)
Supplementary files format and content: CellRanger output files containing VDJ data: airr_rearrangement.tsv, clonotypes.csv, filtered_contig.fasta, filtered_contig_annotations.csv
Library strategy: CITE-seq
